observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a removed valve body from a car gearbox, with visible internal components, bolts, and a black electrical connector with wires.
Photo 1 shows the same valve body from a slightly different angle, with a hand holding a tool near the center, possibly for adjustment or inspection.
Photo 2 shows the valve body from a side view, with a hand holding the outer casing, revealing the internal structure and the black electrical connector.
The valve body is metallic, with signs of use and oil residue, and appears to be from a manual or automatic gearbox.
No visible branding or model markings are readable on the valve body itself in any photo.
The surrounding area includes oil jugs, a black plastic bag, and other automotive parts, suggesting a workshop or repair environment.
The seller claims it is for a Hyundai Accent 2014, but no part number or VIN is visible to confirm compatibility.

claims.claim: Complete gearbox valve body for Hyundai Accent 2014
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model markings on the valve body in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images alone.

risks.risk: The valve body may not fit a Hyundai Accent 2014, or may be from a different model/year.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number or VIN tag on the valve body, or a photo showing the valve body installed in a Hyundai Accent 2014.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incompatible or for a different model, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The valve body may be damaged or worn beyond repair, especially given the visible oil residue and use.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the internal components, particularly the gears, solenoids, and seals, to check for wear, cracks, or leaks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or requiring major repair.

risks.risk: The electrical connector may be damaged or non-functional, which is critical for automatic gearboxes.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the electrical connector with the wires exposed, showing no fraying, corrosion, or broken pins.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or requiring replacement.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
A clear photo of the part number or VIN tag on the valve body.
A close-up photo of the internal components (gears, solenoids, seals) to check for wear or damage.
A close-up photo of the electrical connector with the wires exposed to check for damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
